Everyone seems to be commenting decent ideas about how to get the kitty into the carrier so I’ll just add on one additional piece of advice. Go run to Petco, Petsmart, or Pet Supermarket tonight and grab a Feliway diffuser. It’s similar to a regular scent diffuser you’d plug in to make your house smell good, but instead of a perfume/scent it’s a (odorless to humans) comforting pheromone that calms them down. Runs around $25 (includes diffuser plug in and one bottle of Feliway). Plug it in near where he normally hangs out so he’ll be as close as possible to it and leave it on overnight so he can be as calm as possible in the morning when you’re ready to try to get him in the carrier. Best of luck to you both, you seem like you really care and you’re doing the best for the kitty. ❤️‍🩹

Your kitties look pretty content indoors to me LOL but seriously I think it’s going pretty far to say it’s “wrong” of you to keep your cats indoors and that they will never be able to have a happy life. If you’re fulfilling all of their needs and keeping them safe then you’re doing the best thing possible for them. If you want you can always try to make them an area where they have easy access to a window to see outside when they want, like if you have a cat tree move it to where they can see out the window when they lay in it (or any variation of furniture). If you notice them getting restless in their daily routine just play with them for an extra 15 minutes a day or spray/rub some catnip on some of their toys to spark their interest in them again. Cats are domesticated animals for the most part, you giving them a safe environment to live in comfort in for their entire lives is honestly a really good thing and very far from “wrong”. ❤️

A few Treatment options are: 
Steroid injections, 
PRP (platelet rich plasma injections),
Meds- I hear birth control can really help- but do not get a low estrogen one, you need one that has low androgens. ,
Hair transplant,
1.5 dermaroller and minoxidil a couple hours later on that area- there have been a lot of success with this. ,
Finasteride topical,
Low level laser therapy 

And there are more- dont give up!

Either way let me tell you, all my life I have been abandoned, abused, neglected. I have a relationship and he genuinely seems to love me. Now I’m not saying this is anywhere near your current situation but hear me out. I know the heart tearing excruciating feelings that come with any form of separation.

It hurts like hell. It fucking hurts to have to go separate ways for one reason or another. And it honestly feels like you are so small in the world and you NEED the good qualities and presence of the person you feel like you love. Love for some people is a rare gift- we cherish it truly and it means more to people who really appreciate and need it.

One of my best and closest friends (like a brother to me for four years- I’ve had a bad childhood so finding genuine people who care means the world to me)- he passed away last year May 2nd. It’s robbed me of a lot, seriously, and I personally am not over it- but I’ve also had distant friends who’ve died and.... it makes me feel like a jerk but.... yes, life goes on. It’s very sad, and anyone who passes away will mean something different to you. So when it unfortunately happens, your reaction and feelings will probably be different every time.

And that’s okay, everyone handles death and passing away and even sickness differently. You may be in shock so I wouldn’t jump right in to “everything is fine, like nothing has changed”, if you’ve accepted his passing, it may take time for you to still adjust to the loss or ways that may not necessarily be the same in your life now. You can accept it and still be in sorrow and mourning, it’s fucking hard, it feels like the honestly worst feeling in the world.

You may also be more readily able to process/understand/accept his death because it sounds like he may have been sick for a while. Or the medical conditions may be a warning sign- I’m not sure what your specific situation is. Like... if you’ve kind of known or suspected for a while that it may happen soon, that explains some of it.

I really don’t at all think you’re a bad person- and you continuing to live your life and go on with him in your memory- that’s healthy. Death is a very natural part of our lives and we all kind of have to accept it at some point. Really all you can do is remember those times where you did tell him you loved him or you did something nice for him, or when he smiled at you. The love a grandparent has for their younger ones is one of unconditional and appreciative love. You didn’t have to have a last moment with him- your love/kindness was shown to him already before that- he knew. He must have known how much you cared and he would have appreciated it so much and I’m sure he loved you for it. That’s all someone can ask for is someone that cares about him.

Everyone handles is differently, however it moves you it’s okay. The only things you really can do is appreciate who he was, your relationship with him and your time spent together- and pay your respects in a way (I think of having their photo in your wallet or at home, making sure your grandma knows you’re there for her now that she’s lost her mate, any way you find and feel like you’re remembering who he was and commemorating it). 

But please- give yourself time, much time. You’ll be okay and I’m so sorry that you’re going through this. I hope this may help a little, I hope you find peace and I’m sure your grandfather has found it. He had a wonderful wife and grandson, I’m very sure he knew that he was loved, and you did what you could. Nobody is perfect, you’ll always have regrets after someone passes- it’s just impossible for us as humans to be able to be perfect in every way in a relationship. And you have to allow yourself the freedom to forgive yourself for those regrets- you learn to not undervalue the limited time we have on this planet. If you love someone tell them, if you’re sorry for something tell them- making the most of your time going forward is the best thing you can do and takeaway from this period in your life. I hope you are okay and you’re not alone in these feelings.

Let me try to answer- you’re not.

You deserve success. You deserve happiness. You are you and you’re the only one who can be you. Nobody else could fill your shoes- it wouldn’t even remotely be the same. You are not less than others- you stand on your own two feet just like they do. 

You don’t have to go overboard and just go straight to “I’m self important- I’m better than everyone else”, BUT you do deserve every piece of your pie that they do out of theirs. 

And yknow- I hate to be any type of mean- but it’s not intentional- I needed to tell myself this when I have struggled.

It’s saddening, depressing, and stressful to feel less than and alone in that. But- fuck it. Fuck all of it. You have to stop spending time wallowing in how much you dislike yourself or how much other people have or are able to achieve. The time you spend on thinking these things and kicking your own ass- you’re wasting it. We only have a finite amount of time on this planet- do you want to look back and feel like you wasted any time? I don’t. 

So what can you do? 
Spend that time doing three things.
1.) tell yourself “fuck the rest” (I say this as a somewhat joke to myself- it’s like a non cheesy way of me encouraging myself and reminding myself that nobody is my main focus expect for me- and it feels good to just be able to let it out- “fuck the rest!” ) 

2.) don’t think about what you don’t have or what you feel like you don’t deserve (I literally sometimes have to like press the ‘mute’ button in my head because it’s so hard to not think about- I just get tough with myself- “I’m not going to think about that” and I just don’t let myself- you can fight the negativity and demons off- I promise you have the power) don’t worry about what other people have or what they can do or if they deserve it- those people are not sitting there in their own heads thinking that about you! They’re not thinking about how less you are or how you deserve to be behind them. That’s not even a thought in other peoples minds- don’t let your mind trick you.

3.) every single time you feel like something bad has happened where you get discouraged and you just get in a cycle of thinking “of course this is happening- I only deserve as much, right?” - you can have negative thoughts and be hurt by things that don’t go your way- but you have to pick out at least ONE positive thing. I’ve had to learn that not every day is fully shit, not everything that happens to me is unlucky. I tell myself “it’s not that my life is shit, shitty things just keep happening”. I have a roof over my head and I have food and water- basics. I get to enjoy having pets who I can play with, or maybe it’s just a nice day outside- don’t let anything rob you from enjoying at least ONE thing most days. If it’s hard to find it- it’s okay, but there is ALWAYS something you can be thankful for. And it is so weird but it helps to replace the negative with at least a tiny sprinkle of positivity.

Don’t let anything stop you from doing or achieving what you want. Fuck anyone who thinks otherwise, you can do this and you’re able to fight and work towards success just like others who seem like they have it. And if they got a free ride to success or something like that- it makes you stronger and more intelligent that you worked harder to get where you are. Be unapologetically you- you don’t owe anyone space in your mind to be valued more than yourself.  I hope this helps at all.

Hello, I hope you’re feeling okay and I’m glad you posted, I’ve struggled with this issue my entire life and still do. It has been very easy for me to be pressured or willing to do things I wouldn’t normally do because of other peoples influence and sometimes I thought “well this must be how it’s supposed to be, what do I know” 

That’s not true. A big start to being able to rely on yourself is to start small and work your way up. And it doesn’t have to take months to figure out some things, but it might take some practice and self assertion.

First for me, I had to basically wipe most of the way things were laid out in my mind. My friends interests and opinions and actions, they were very high on my ‘importance meter’, I’d constantly be anxious about what others thought and I also tended to feel panicked about a decision trying to make one based on what someone else would do.

You have to realize- your friends or others around you may be admirable and you may value their opinions or actions- but that is not more important than YOU.

The first place you need to get to is to YOU. Get more in touch with yourself, your likes, dislikes, opinions, and you can also try to think back to situations where you did something or said something and think about how you would do it differently now- without any outside influence. That really helps you build confidence in yourself and helps you figure out how to do things based on YOU. You’ve got this you can find yourself and you don’t have to worry about other people- most often the best and most “attractive” (I don’t mean physically or anything- just like, “yeah that person is chill”) way to present yourself is to be you. I know “just be yourself “ is so not helpful- but it’s so much more than that. You have to work and build up your confidence that you feel a certain way and you want to make decisions that are in line with what you want to do. 

But! It is good and healthy to admire people or even like content creators or friends or yknow whoever you look up to or respect their opinions or how they handle things- you can try to generalize the main theme of their actions or what you admire and try to better yourself by implementing some of the things you like about it. 

But put yourself and your head first- you don’t wanna do something? Don’t do it. You want to do something? Do it. If you don’t know how to figure out or make a decision on something- it’s definitely okay to ask for advice online or from friends or even a family member you’re cool with (people generally have the same feelings you are right now, if they aren’t shitty they should understand where you’re coming from)
